name: hiring-signals-by-domain
title: Hiring Signals by Company Domain: Open Roles, Teams, Velocity
description: Turn company domains into hiring signals: is the company hiring, open role count, jobs by function and seniority, leadership hires, top locations, remote share and roles posted in the last 7/30 days. Finds the job board from the company's own site (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee). One row per domain.
